# Branch Naming Standards

## Format
`category/feature-name-timestamp`

## Categories
- `feature/` - New features
- `fix/` - Bug fixes
- `todo/` - TODO item implementations
- `refactor/` - Code refactoring
- `test/` - Test implementations
- `audit/` - Code audits/verification
- `docs/` - Documentation

## Examples
- `feature/ui-widget-system-123456789`
- `todo/processor-04-features-123456789`
- `fix/memory-leak-detection-123456789`

## Pre-Merge Checklist
1. Search for similar feature branches
2. Check if feature already exists in main
3. Run duplicate detection script
4. Get review from subsystem owner
